details.description: This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office **Who are we looking for?Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer 1 within our Guest and Loyalty Domain. This team drives the systems powering our loyalty program and guest engagement data. As a key contributor, you’ll participate in the full development lifecycle—analyzing complex problems, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping build the future of our platform.We’re looking for an ambitious and inquisitive engineer, someone who thrives on learning, embraces new technology, and is excited by the opportunity to build impactful systems in a collaborative environment.If you’re a self-starter who enjoys technology and solving meaningful problems, we invite you to apply today and #MakeItYourChoice.Your ResponsibilitiesAnalyze user stories and develop secure, maintainable Java code with Spring frameworks. Use agentic AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity and code quality. Contribute to design discussions, peer code reviews, and integration testing efforts. Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Support CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments (AWS). Assist with monitoring and debugging production systems using tools like Prometheus and OpenSearch. Partner closely with QA for validation and test planning. Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support production systems. Stay current on new technologies, frameworks, and software development best practices. Your Experience, Skills & CompetenciesBachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. 1–2 years of Java (v1.8+) development experience with Spring (REST, MVC, Security). Hands-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments. Experience with collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence. Familiarity with REST API design and consumption patterns Source control proficiency – Bitbucket / Git workflows, branching strategies, and merge conflict resolution Comfort using modern Java IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA or Visual Studio Code, and build tools such as Maven or Gradle Understanding of secure coding practices and fundamentals of application security Strong debugging habits and experience working with logs and monitoring tools SQL/relational database fundamentals Good verbal, written, and listening communication skills Good interpersonal skills and demeanor A curious, growth-oriented mindset and an eagerness to explore tools like Copilot, Claude, or other AI-powered developer assistants Your Team This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Software Engineering in the Guest & Loyalty Domain. You’ll be part of a tight-knit, collaborative team of 5–7 engineers, working alongside cross-functional partners in product, QA, and architecture. PLEASE NOTE: This role is not eligible for sponsorship *** Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverageLeave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observanceFinancial benefits for retirement and health savingsEmployee recognition programsDiscounts at Choice hotels worldwideAbout ChoiceChoice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.Our corporate office locations:North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.Choice’s Cultural ValuesWelcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show IntegrityChoice’s Leadership PrinciplesAct with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Job DescriptionSoftware Engineer 1We are LennarLennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.Join a Company that Empowers You to Build Your FutureWe are seeking an early-career back-end/full-stack Software Engineer to join our team building and evolving our flagship digital web presence. The ideal candidate has foundational experience (through internships, projects, coursework, or early professional work) with .NET services, SQL (SQL Server a plus), and an interest in learning to design and operate GraphQL and RESTful APIs. You will work alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional partners to help deliver reliable, secure integrations across application services, data stores, and CMS capabilities (Optimizely exposure is a nice-to-have). Front-end experience (e.g., Next.js) is a bonus but not required. Above all, we're looking for someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute.Your Responsibilities On The TeamSoftware Development: Develop and maintain back-end and full-stack services with guidance, ensuring scalability, performance, reliability, and security.Write clean, readable, and maintainable code, learning and applying best practices and coding standards.Help build back-end services using .NET and contribute to API layers leveraging GraphQL (and REST as needed); learn to write and optimize data access patterns with SQL (preferably SQL Server). Front-end development in React/Next.js is a plus.Leverage AI tooling to supercharge productivity and accelerate your learning.Architecture and Design: Learn the architecture and design of software systems and how they align with business goals and technical strategy.Participate in technical design reviews, asking questions and contributing ideas as you grow your understanding.Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to ensure software quality.Help identify and resolve defects and performance issues, and participate in code reviews to learn and uphold high standards of code quality.Work closely with QA teams to understand and apply testing strategies and processes.Collaboration and Teamwork: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality features and enhancements.Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to the continuous improvement of the team’s processes.Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing updates on progress and potential challenges.Help troubleshoot and resolve incidents as needed.Growth and Development: Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers, applying what you learn to improve your skills.Demonstrate a strong work ethic, a commitment to quality, and a willingness to take on new challenges.Take ownership of features or projects, driving them from concept to completion with appropriate guidance and support.Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Stay curious about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team.Identify opportunities for process improvements, refactoring, or technical enhancements to optimize the software development lifecycle. Participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the team’s technical direction.RequirementsEducation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.Experience: 0-2 years in software engineering, with an interest in back-end and full-stack development across modern web platforms..NET / API Foundations: Some exposure to building scalable services using .NET and an eagerness to learn API design with GraphQL and REST.Data & CMS Integration: Familiarity with relational data modeling and SQL Server; any experience with SQL Server or CMS platforms (Optimizely a plus) is a bonus.Cloud Exposure: Familiarity with deploying to or working with cloud services (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) is a plus.Agile Mindset: Openness to working in agile environments and adapting quickly to evolving requirements and priorities.Problem Solving: Solid analytical skills with a detail-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to ownership and accountability.Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.Initiative & Drive: Self-starter with a passion for technology, continuous learning, and driving projects forward.Integrity & Quality: Committed to delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions with professionalism and accountability.Additional SkillsWhile this role is primarily back-end/full-stack focused, experience in these areas is a plus:CMS & Platform Engineering: Any experience with or interest in CMS platforms, with Optimizely a nice-to-have (content delivery, personalization, workflows, and integrations).Cloud & Infrastructure: Basic familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.CI/CD & DevOps: Any exposure to version control (Git) and CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps (ADO) or GitHub Actions is a plus.Architecture & Databases: An interest in learning API architecture (GraphQL and REST), service design, and database design with SQL Server.Front-End Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with front-end engineers and, when needed, contribute to UI work in React/Next.js is a plus.Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.Life at LennarAt Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities.Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. details.description: Location: Fully Remote (USA) · Timezone-aligned Compensation: 80k–100k + Equity + Quarterly Performance BonusesThe Mission: Transforming Businesses for the AI AgeMany businesses still depend on disconnected software, spreadsheets, manual processes, and knowledge trapped inside individual employees’ heads. Lumion brings those systems and processes together so organizations can operate more intelligently and efficiently.We are starting with trade and technical schools. Our platform powers the entire institution, from the first lead through enrollment, tuition payments, compliance reporting, graduation, and career tracking.These schools prepare electricians, welders, nurses, technicians, and other skilled professionals who keep the country moving. By modernizing their operations, Lumion helps them serve more students and strengthen the skilled workforce.The Opportunity: Learn How Software Will Be Built in the FutureThis is a place to launch your career at the cutting edge of software development. You will learn how coding will be done in the future and become part of the wave changing how software is created.Our stack and development processes are AI First. Claude Code and Codex are part of our normal workflow, with access to the latest frontier models without having to ration tokens or worry about usage limits. You will learn the workflows, judgment, and verification practices required to use these systems effectively and become a 100x developer.Working at a startup also gives you the opportunity to wear different hats and see problems from engineering, product, customer, and business perspectives. You will gain experience that is difficult to find when working inside one narrow area of a larger company.If you want a fast moving environment, the excitement of solving new problems, and the chance to look back proudly on helping build something significant, this is that opportunity.The Role: Code at the Speed of ThoughtYour work will span backend business logic, data models, APIs, integrations, administrative workflows, customer facing interfaces, and automated tests.You will be a full member of the engineering team from day one and trusted with meaningful production work. Important assignments are not reserved for people with longer résumés. You will be held to the same standards for quality, communication, and follow through as every other engineer at Lumion.What We’re Looking ForProfessional software engineering experience is not required.A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is required. The degree must be completed before your employment begins. Current students may apply if they will graduate before their start date.Evidence that you have put your programming skills into practice. This can come from a capstone, internship, personal project, open source contribution, research project, freelance engagement, or another hands on project. We want to understand what you worked on, what you personally contributed, and what you learned.Confidence in at least one programming language. You can build with it, debug it, and explain the logic behind your decisions. The language does not need to be PHP, and prior Laravel experience is not required.An understanding of web development fundamentals. You are familiar with concepts such as HTTP, APIs, authentication, databases, browser interfaces, version control, and automated testing.Logical problem solving. You can break an unfamiliar problem into manageable parts, investigate failures systematically, and work toward the underlying cause.Product judgment. You consider the person using the software and connect technical decisions to the problem being solved.How We WorkLumion is a high trust team. We share context openly, keep our egos low, raise risks early, and ask questions when something does not make sense.To show that you read the entire posting, tell us in your application what you would do with a golden banana. There are no wrong answers except not answering.The StackOur current application stack includes:Application: PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12+, Livewire, Filament, Blade, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSSData: MySQL, Redis, pgvector, and PineconeTesting: Pest PHPWhy Join Lumion Now?Lumion closed a $10.7 million seed round backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners. More than 400 career schools use our platform to support over 150,000 students across 48 states and 29 industries.Schools using Lumion see 47% more completed applications, a 73.6% application to enrollment rate, 91% on time tuition collection, and 21% higher student retention.We have the capital and momentum to build something that lasts while remaining early enough for every engineer to influence the product and company.Remote FirstThis is a full time remote position. You must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States. Your normal workday must overlap by at least six hours with our Salt Lake City team.Compensation and BenefitsSalary: $80,000 to $100,000 USDEquity: Meaningful stock optionsBonuses: Quarterly performance based cash bonusesTime Off: Unlimited paid time offRetirement: 401(k)Health: Health, dental, and vision reimbursement up to $537.50 per monthTechnology: $200 monthly technology stipendWellness: $100 monthly wellness stipend

Embedded in an engineering team under an Engineering Team Lead, this role is focused on delivering assigned work with quality, learning the insurance domain, and developing the technical judgment needed to contribute more independently over time.The Software Engineer I is expected to implement well-defined tasks, ask questions early, communicate progress clearly, and participate in testing, debugging, and operational support with guidance from more experienced engineers.Reporting and ScopeReports to: Engineering Team LeadWorks with: Engineers on the team, Delivery Lead, underwriting/business stakeholders, internal systems teams, and external vendors as neededCareer framework alignment: Entry-level role on the Software Engineer ladder; this description is specific to SDE1How the Role Fits the Operating ModelThe Software Engineer I is on the supply side of the prioritization triangle, helping turn requirements from the Team Lead and Delivery Lead into working software on the policy administration platform. This role learns the insurance domain — including quoting, binding, endorsements, rating, forms, and the policy lifecycle — and applies that context to complete assigned development work.Key ResponsibilitiesBuild and maintain: Build and maintain APIs, workflows, integrations, and tooling supporting underwriting and policy administration systems.Implement defined work: Complete assigned stories, tasks, bug fixes, tests, and documentation based on clear requirements and acceptance criteria.Write quality code: Write modular, maintainable code with guidance and proactively ask for help when needed.Support operational workflows: Work with engineering leads and business stakeholders to support operational workflow implementation.Contribute to integrations: Assist with integrations between internal systems, external vendors, and policy administration platforms under guidance from senior engineers.Participate in production support: Support debugging, testing, automation, and operational support for production systems, escalating issues appropriately.Improve tooling: Help improve internal engineering tooling and developer workflows by identifying small opportunities for efficiency and quality.Use AI-assisted engineering: Use AI-assisted engineering workflows, including Claude Code or similar tools, to support development speed, code quality, testing, and documentation.Learn the domain: Build understanding of insurance domain concepts including quoting, binding, endorsements, rating, forms, and the policy lifecycle.Demonstrate ownership: Take ownership of assigned work, follow through on commitments, incorporate feedback, and demonstrate curiosity when working through unfamiliar problems.CompetenciesTechnical Ability: Implements assigned tasks, bug fixes, tests, and documentation; writes modular, maintainable code with guidance; demonstrates growing fluency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript and modern engineering practices.Communication: Communicates progress, blockers, and risks clearly; keeps stories and tasks up to date; asks clarifying questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear.Critical Thinking: Applies a structured approach to problem solving, adjusts when new information becomes available, and looks for simple, practical solutions before escalating.Organizational Contribution: Participates actively in team rituals, code reviews, and engineering discussions; shares observations and feedback in a constructive way.Business Impact: Delivers assigned work on time and with quality; begins to understand how engineering work supports underwriting, policy administration, and business operations.Qualifications1+ year of software engineering experience.Strong foundational skills in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.Familiarity with APIs, integrations, automated testing, debugging, and modern development workflows.Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools, with Claude Code strongly preferred.Eagerness to learn the insurance domain and apply business context to technical work.Strong communication skills, curiosity, accountability, and willingness to ask for help when needed.Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.
